subtitle: Sovereign Gear & Talent Mastery
changes: Added source-backed equipped-item comparisons directly beneath Character Intelligence, using only previously returned Blizzard Armory records.
Compare two equipment records by official ID, name, slot and item level, including a signed level difference when both values are available and warnings when comparing different equipment slots.
Open either compared item with the original Item Codex inspector, retaining its existing API validation and error handling.
Introduced a read-only Talent Forge context summary showing separately planned Class, Specialization and Hero rank totals without misrepresenting them as active in-game talents.
No additional network requests, new sign-in permissions, manual data writes or changes to Talent Forge allocations, saved builds, music, studio archive or Discord announcements.
